content:
With hot storage, you pay for what you provision. Some instances require an attached Amazon EBS
volume, while others include an instance store. Whether that storage is empty or full, you pay the
same price.
With UltraWarm storage, you pay for what you use. An ultrawarm1.large.search instance can
address up to 20 TiB of storage on S3, but if you store only 1 TiB of data, you're only billed for 1
TiB of data. Like all other node types, you also pay an hourly rate for each UltraWarm node. For
more information, see the section called “Pricing”.

hierarchy.parent: UltraWarm storage for Amazon OpenSearch Service
